1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

2151|bdcb2ee4.name: Moon Priestess Amara
2151|bdcb2ee4.text: Hail, $C.  The roads of our fair forest are not entirely without peril.  Tread cautiously.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256391|209fae46.name: Elaine Compton
256391|209fae46.text:
Not every order goes according to plan. While we strive to ensure that each delivery arrives intact and efficiently, a recent rise of beasts, bandits, and even Horde attacks, unfortunately cause some unavoidable loss of goods.

Should you find any lost shipments and are feeling particularly helpful, you can take a look over the label and identify its expected contents. It is not your responsibility to deal with our shortcomings of course, but if you completed the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind.

Ms. Baker near the crates will handle your compensation, and we will take care of the logistics from there.

256391|3090047f.name: Elaine Compton
256391|3090047f.text:
Oh goodness, you snuck up on me! Glad to see you, $N, the Azeroth Commerce Authority is always in need of new contractors.

If you are the sort to enjoy a stroll through the forest gathering useful materials or possess the skills to craft something from scratch, well, you have found yourself right at home!

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256729|06bc17cb.name: Nina Surefire
256729|06bc17cb.text:
I know what you're thinking, but don't worry, we keep our cooking and alchemy ingredients separate!

How can I help you?

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

256733|8265ab1b.name: Fritz Fizzle
256733|8265ab1b.text: Pleased to meet you! If you like to tinker, you have come to the right place!

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

258572|cad23935.name: Dani'ill
258572|cad23935.text: Many of the supplies that tradesmen need can be found in the world. For those that cannot, I provide a limited selection for fair price.

268511|ee845bad.name: Manifest Clerk Philmor
268511|ee845bad.text: Harbor work is open to everyone, but your personal safety is your own responsibility.

276318|6ecded70.name: Idrieth Mossgrove
276318|6ecded70.text: This dock connects Stormwind to the lands of the kaldorei via Auberdine, the port town of Darkshore. If you wish to travel there, the boat arrives frequently.

3567|8f79505e.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|8f79505e.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that hunters like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3605|c7a4e3ad.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|c7a4e3ad.text: Welcome to our home, $N. Radnaal and I have little to offer, but you are welcome to what hospitality we can provide.

5482|8cd6b7fd.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

5493|e332eb6d.name: Arnold Leland
5493|e332eb6d.text: Ah, a fellow Fisherman. Are you perhaps in need of a little training? Maybe I can show you a thing or two?

5497|8fca8484.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

106-complete.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-complete.text: Ah!  I can't stand us being apart.  I have to see her!!
106-complete.title: Young Lovers

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-accept.name: Gramma Stonefield
107-accept.text:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
107-accept.title: Note to William

107-complete.name: William Pestle
107-complete.text:
My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe.  I remember being young and in love, once.

There must be something I can do to help them!  Let me think...
107-complete.title: Note to William

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

109-accept.name: Farmer Furlbrow
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

111-accept.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
111-accept.text:
Please, $N, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.
111-accept.title: Speak with Gramma

111-complete.name: Gramma Stonefield
111-complete.text:
While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...
111-complete.title: Speak with Gramma

112-accept.name: William Pestle
112-accept.text:
I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe.  But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.

Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it.  See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any.  Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
112-accept.title: Collecting Kelp

123-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
123-progress.text:
What?!?  We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!

Let me see that note you have...
123-progress.title: The Collector

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

184-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-progress.text:
You have the deed to my farm??  That's good news!  Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!

Please, let me have it.  We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
184-progress.title: Furlbrow's Deed

1861-progress.name: Jennea Cannon
1861-progress.text: Do you have the sample, $N?  The flow of magic in Stormwind and Elwynn has been altered, and I must know if it is seeping into the water.
1861-progress.title: Mirror Lake

2159-progress.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-progress.text: How might I be of service to you, young one?  Are you here to rest in the inn?  Do you require a hearthstone?
2159-progress.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2438-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-progress.text:
Please move swiftly. I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

Have you recovered it yet, $N?
2438-progress.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2459-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-progress.text: Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine mystics must return what is mine.  Please retrieve the emerald so that I may repair my emerald dreamcatcher.
2459-progress.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

488-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-progress.text: Have you been a busy little bee, $N?  I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.
488-progress.title: Zenn's Bidding

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

490-accept.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-accept.text:
By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.

As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.
490-accept.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-complete.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-complete.text: You have served well, $N. You shall be rewarded for your contribution.
490-complete.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-progress.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-progress.text: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
490-progress.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

6063-progress.name: Dazalar
6063-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
6063-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6101-progress.name: Dazalar
6101-progress.text: Understanding the balance between nature and oneself is a way of life for every $r.
6101-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6102-progress.name: Dazalar
6102-progress.text: I am proud of your accomplishments, $N. Have you finished the last task I gave you?
6102-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6392-progress.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-progress.text: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
6392-progress.title: Return to Brock

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

79093-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79093-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79093-progress.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

86667-accept.name: Grenhild Darktalon
86667-accept.text:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667-accept.title: Snowbound

86667-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
86667-complete.text:
This jar is for me?

Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!

A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.

Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.
86667-complete.title: Snowbound

87288-accept.name: Aldia
87288-accept.text:
Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
87288-accept.title: Soft Saber Pelts

87288-complete.name: Aldia
87288-complete.text:
Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.

Here, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.
87288-complete.title: Soft Saber Pelts

87288-progress.name: Aldia
87288-progress.text: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288-progress.title: Soft Saber Pelts

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

91751-accept.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-accept.text: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
91751-accept.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

922-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-progress.text:
Hello...

And how may I help you?
922-progress.title: Rellian Greenspyre

928-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-progress.text: Greetings, $c. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
928-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

92909-accept.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-accept.text:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
92909-accept.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

930-progress.name: Denalan
930-progress.text: $N, you look like you have something to tell me.  Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
930-progress.title: The Glowing Fruit

933-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-progress.text: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
933-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

95065-accept.name: Gilbert Gray
95065-accept.text:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
95065-accept.title: Fishin' Time

95065-complete.name: Gilbert Gray
95065-complete.text:
Great timing! Caught a big one with my last bait. Great day so far. They're really biting out here!

Tell you what, since you were kind enough to keep this old man in business how about a few fish for the road?
95065-complete.title: Fishin' Time

95065-progress.name: Gilbert Gray
95065-progress.text: Did you get the fishing supplies?
95065-progress.title: Fishin' Time

96606-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96606-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96606-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96606-complete.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96606-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96606-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96630-complete.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96630-complete.title: The Adventurer

96630-progress.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96630-progress.title: The Adventurer

96634-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96634-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96634-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96634-complete.name: Zarrin
96634-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96634-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97220-accept.name: Manifest Clerk Philmor
97220-accept.text:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
97220-accept.title: Philmor's Favor

97220-complete.name: Elaine Trias
97220-complete.text: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.
97220-complete.title: Philmor's Favor

97220-progress.name: Elaine Trias
97220-progress.text: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
97220-progress.title: Philmor's Favor

97222-accept.name: Elaine Trias
97222-accept.text:
Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself! 

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.
97222-accept.title: Gatehouse Goods

97222-complete.name: Elaine Trias
97222-complete.text:
Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.

Consider us professionally acquainted, $c. 

We respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.
97222-complete.title: Gatehouse Goods

97222-progress.name: Elaine Trias
97222-progress.text: You should at least try some of this aged cheddar. You can't stop eating it.
97222-progress.title: Gatehouse Goods

97286-complete.name: Garion Wendell
97286-complete.text: Your actions show you are one who respects knowledge. The library is open for use in your studies.
97286-complete.title: Research Access

97942-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97942-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97942-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97946-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97946-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97946-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97949-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97949-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97949-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97949-complete.name: Radnaal Maneweaver
97949-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97949-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

98067-accept.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-accept.text:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067-accept.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98067-complete.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-complete.text: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.
98067-complete.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98391-accept.name: Laurna Morninglight
98391-accept.text:
Blessings to you, $c. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391-accept.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98391-complete.name: Sister Aquinne
98391-complete.text: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.
98391-complete.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

99046-accept.name: Sentinel Kyra Starsong
99046-accept.text:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
99046-accept.title: The Lost Runner

99127-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99127-accept.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight, go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127-accept.title: A Net Disaster

99127-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99127-complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.
99127-complete.title: A Net Disaster

99128-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99128-accept.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128-accept.title: Slimy Menace

99143-accept.name: Lee Brown
99143-accept.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143-accept.title: Bottles and Baubles

99159-accept.name: Father Gavin
99159-accept.text:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
99159-accept.title: Finding Warmth
